rows.name: POINT OF AYRE
rows.description: White stone tower, 99 ft. high, ½ mile S.W. of the point. Light bright and red alternately

rows.name: Peel Harbour
rows.description: Red light on end of old pier; bright light on end of North breakwater

rows.name: Port Erin
rows.description: New breakwater partly destroyed, and covered at high water; black buoy marks o[?]ter end. Lts., 130 ft. apart, on E. shore, in l[?]e lead in

rows.name: CHICKEN ROCK
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: Granite tower, 143 ft. high, [?] mile West from South extremity of Calf of Man

rows.name: Port St. Mary
rows.character: 1. Two fixed lights 2. One fixed green light
rows.description: 1. Bright light on pier, in line with red light on hill on West side of port, lead in 2. On extremity of new breakwater at Port St. Mary Point

rows.name: Castletown Harbour
rows.description: On new pier-head. Visible seaward between the entrance points of the bay

rows.name: LANGNESS
rows.description: Lighthouse, 63 ft. high, on S.E. part of point. Light shows a flash every 5 secs.

rows.name: Derby Haven
rows.description: Fishing lt. on S.W. end of breakwater. (Aug. 12 to Oct. 10)

rows.name: DOUGLAS
rows.description: White stone tower, 65 feet high, on Douglas Head. Light obscured inshore of S.W. [?] W.

rows.name: Douglas Harbour
rows.description: Red light on Battery pier. Bright light on inner pier, while 9 ft. on the bar

rows.name: Douglas Bay
rows.description: A blue light on end of promenade pier. Green light on end of Victoria pier, visible between E.N.E. and S. by E.

rows.name: Ramsey Bay
rows.description: Shown vertically, near extr. of landing-pier, at 600 yds. southward of harbour entrance...

rows.name: Ramsey Harbour
rows.description: Red light on South pier-head, green light on North pier-head

rows.name: BAHAMA BANK LT.-V.
rows.description: In 11 fathoms, off S.E. end of bank. Light shows 2 quick flashes, followed by 20 secs. darkness. Red, with ball

rows.name: Clacton
rows.description: One fixed red light on end of pier

rows.name: HARWICH
rows.description: Pile lt.-houses, 208 yds. apart, on shore abreast Dovercourt. In one, bearing N.W. by W. [?] W., lead betw. the Inner Ridge & Andrews buoys. High light shown from S. [?] E. to E. by N.; low light only shown between S.E. by E. and E. by S. [?] S.

rows.name: Jetties
rows.description: Red light on North jetty, visible betw. East and E. by N. [?] N.; anchorage forbidden. Green light on West jetty and on East jetty Three fixed red lights on Parkeston quay, and a fixed red light on end of Felixtow pier

rows.name: Landguard Point
rows.character: One fix. red or br. lt.
rows.description: A red light outside, betw. S.S.E. and S.W., to Beach End buoy; bright to West. A strip of red light betw. N.W. by N. [?] N. and N. by W. [?] W. to clear the North Shelf buoy. A fixed green light on Landguard Fort jetty...

rows.name: Woodbridge Haven
rows.description: Two small fixed bright lights on West side ...

rows.name: Cork Lightvessel
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: In 4½ fathoms, near Cork Ledge. Red, with ball at mast-head

rows.name: SHIPWASH LT.-VESSEL
rows.description: In 9 fathoms, off N.E. end of Sand. Red, with ball at mast-head. A long flash betw. two short flashes, followed by 14 secs. eclipse ...

rows.name: Outer Gabbard Shoal
rows.description: Lightvessel proposed

rows.name: ORFORDNESS
rows.character: Two fix. br. or red lts. (High light to South)
rows.description: Towers, 99 and 72 ft. high, with red and white bands, S.W. [?] W. and N.E. [?] E., 1,439 yds. apart. In one, from South, lead through Hollesley Bay, but very close to the N.W. edge of the Whiting Sand; from North, between Sizewell Bank and Aldbro' Napes, &c. High light is red from W. by S. to W.S.W. over shoals in Hollesley Bay; the rest bright. Low light is red over Sizewell Bank, from N.E. to N.E. [?] N.; then masked in-shore. The rest bright

rows.name: Southwould
rows.description: Three small fixed bright gas lights on the cliff

rows.name: Kessingland or Pakefield
rows.description: On cliff, N.E. side of Kessingland fish-houses; shown through Gat betw. E. [?] N. & S.E. [?] E.
